io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.full_description: Verifiable physical randomness from cosmic-ray muon detections. Seal your options as a hash, the next detected muon determines the outcome, receive a certificate dual-signed with Ed25519 and ML-DSA. Free public beacon; paid decisions settled per call via x402 in USDC, no account or API key. Throughput is bounded by physics: about one event every few seconds. Not for cryptographic key material. The certificate format supports multi-node attestation; the federation protocol is published as an open proposal. Today: one detector, one operator, one attestation per certificate.

tool_descriptions.costheta_decide: Paid commit-and-reveal decision. Send a hash of your options; the next detected muon selects one and you receive a publicly verifiable, dual-signed certificate binding your commitment to that physical event. Latency up to ~30 s. $0.02 via x402/USDC.
tool_descriptions.costheta_random: Free public beacon. Random bits derived from muon arrival timestamps on the latest signed pulse. Shared by all callers until the next muon arrives; for private, request-bound outcomes use costheta_decide. Not for cryptographic keys.
tool_descriptions.costheta_witness: Paid timestamp attestation. Binds any hash you send to the next detected muon and signs the pair: a timestamp anchored to a physical detection, not a server clock. $0.02 via x402/USDC.
